trajectory_summary: The call opens with quick, easy cooperation and a customer volunteering his own availability — a strong start the rep barely had to work for. But the rep never locks the offered Tuesday 1:30 slot before qualifying and address-checking, and once the customer's schedule falls apart, the rep settles for an unanchored text-and-callback with no committed time. Energy leaked from a promising open into a soft, ownerless exit.
outcome_dispute: This should not be read as tentative/booked — no day or time was actually confirmed by the end; it is best read as a callback with only a vague 'after 3PM tomorrow' window, and even that wasn't restated or locked by the rep.

observed_outcome.reasoning: No day or time was locked by either party by the end of the call; the rep agreed to text and wait for the customer to state availability, with only a vague 'call me after 3PM tomorrow' from the customer, so this is a callback without a confirmed slot rather than booked or tentative.
